pages.title: Getting Another Copy
pages.text: Run $(o)/mc3dprint guide$(). It hands out a fresh, working Handbook, and $(l)any player$() can run it - this is documentation, not loot.$(br2)The book arrives automatically the first time you craft a printer or pick up a $(item)Blueprint Disc$(), but only $(l)once per player$(), so losing it used to be permanent.$(br2)Operators can hand copies to other players with $(o)/mc3dprint guide <players>$().

pages.title: Why /give Doesn't Work
pages.text: This Handbook is a $(l)Patchouli$() book, so its item id is $(o)patchouli:guide_book$() - there is no $(o)mc3dprint:$() id to give.$(br2)A plain $(o)/give$() of that item produces an $(l)unbound$() copy: it reads $(c:red)Invalid book: no ID defined$() and won't open, because the book a stack points at lives in a data component the command doesn't set.$(br2)$(o)/mc3dprint guide$() sets it correctly. Use that instead.
